title: Application for approval by Boston Gas Company of a 334 Day Transportation Agreement with Harrington Memorial Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed transportation service. The Department finds that the pricing terms and minimum quality of therms to be purchased under the agreement are competitively sensitive, therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
